versos.grego: Ἰάκωβος Θεοῦ καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δοῦλος ταῖς δώδεκα φυλαῖς ταῖς ἐν τῇ Διασπορᾷ χαίρειν.

controles.web: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.
controles.kjv: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
controles.livre: Tiago, servo de Deus e do Senhor Jesus Cristo, às doze tribos que estão na dispersão, saudações!

versos.grego: Πᾶσαν χαρὰν ἡγήσασθε, ἀδελφοί μου, ὅταν πειρασμοῖς περιπέσητε ποικίλοις,

controles.web: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,
controles.kjv: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
controles.livre: Meus irmãos, tende toda alegria quando vos encontrardes em várias provações,

versos.grego: γινώσκοντες ὅτι τὸ δοκίμιον ὑμῶν τῆς πίστεως κατεργάζεται ὑπομονήν.

controles.web: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
controles.kjv: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
controles.livre: sabendo que a prova da vossa fé produz perseverança.

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ ὑπομονὴ ἔργον τέλειον ἐχέτω, ἵνα ἦτε τέλειοι καὶ ὁλόκληροι, ἐν μηδενὶ λειπόμενοι.

controles.web: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
controles.kjv: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
controles.livre: E que a perseverança tenha uma realização completa, para que sejais completos e íntegros, faltando em nada.

versos.grego: Εἰ δέ τις ὑμῶν λείπεται σοφίας, αἰτείτω παρὰ τοῦ διδόντος Θεοῦ πᾶσιν ἁπλῶς καὶ μὴ ὀνειδίζοντος, καὶ δοθήσεται αὐτῷ.

controles.web: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach; and it will be given to him.
controles.kjv: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
controles.livre: Se algum de vós tem falta de sabedoria, peça a Deus, que concede generosamente a todos sem repreender, e lhe será dada.

versos.grego: αἰτείτω δὲ ἐν πίστει, μηδὲν διακρινόμενος· ὁ γὰρ διακρινόμενος ἔοικεν κλύδωνι θαλάσσης ἀνεμιζομένῳ καὶ ῥιπιζομένῳ.

controles.web: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.
controles.kjv: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
controles.livre: Porém deves pedi-la em fé, duvidando em nada; pois quem duvida é semelhante à onda do mar que é levada pelo vento, e lançada.

versos.grego: μὴ γὰρ οἰέσθω ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖνος ὅτι λήμψεταί τι παρὰ τοῦ Κυρίου,

controles.web: For let that man not think that he will receive anything from the Lord.
controles.kjv: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
controles.livre: Tal pessoa não pense que receberá algo do Senhor.

versos.grego: ἀνὴρ δίψυχος, ἀκατάστατος ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
controles.kjv: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
controles.livre: O homem de dupla mentalidade é inconstante em todos os seus caminhos.

versos.grego: Καυχάσθω δὲ ὁ ἀδελφὸς ὁ ταπεινὸς ἐν τῷ ὕψει αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: But let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;
controles.kjv: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
controles.livre: Mas o irmão que é humilde se orgulhe quando é exaltado,

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ πλούσιος ἐν τῇ ταπεινώσει αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ὡς ἄνθος χόρτου παρελεύσεται.

controles.web: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.
controles.kjv: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
controles.livre: e o que é rico quando é abatido, porque ele passará como a flor da erva.

versos.grego: ἀνέτειλεν γὰρ ὁ ἥλιος σὺν τῷ καύσωνι καὶ ἐξήρανεν τὸν χόρτον, καὶ τὸ ἄνθος αὐτοῦ ἐξέπεσεν καὶ ἡ εὐπρέπεια τοῦ προσώπου αὐτοῦ ἀπώλετο· οὕτως καὶ ὁ πλούσιος ἐν ταῖς πορείαις αὐτοῦ μαρανθήσεται.

controles.web: For the sun arises with the scorching wind, and withers the grass, and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So also will the rich man fade away in his pursuits.
controles.kjv: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
controles.livre: Pois o sol sai com ardor, então seca a erva, a sua flor cai, e a beleza do seu aspecto perece; assim também o rico murchará nos seus caminhos.

versos.grego: Μακάριος ἀνὴρ ὃς ὑπομένει πειρασμόν, ὅτι δόκιμος γενόμενος λήμψεται τὸν στέφανον τῆς ζωῆς, ὃν ἐπηγγείλατο τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν αὐτόν.

controles.web: Blessed is the man who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life, which the Lord promised to those who love him.
controles.kjv: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
controles.livre: Bendito  é o homem que suporta a provação; pois, quando for aprovado, receberá a coroa da vida, que o Senhor prometeu aos que o amam.

versos.grego: Μηδεὶς πειραζόμενος λεγέτω ὅτι Ἀπὸ Θεοῦ πειράζομαι· ὁ γὰρ Θεὸς ἀπείραστός ἐστιν κακῶν, πειράζει δὲ αὐτὸς οὐδένα.

controles.web: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.
controles.kjv: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
controles.livre: Ninguém, quando for tentado, diga: “Sou tentado por Deus”; porque Deus não é tentado pelo mal, e ele mesmo tenta ninguém;

versos.grego: ἕκαστος δὲ πειράζεται ὑπὸ τῆς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας ἐξελκόμενος καὶ δελεαζόμενος·

controles.web: But each one is tempted, when he is drawn away by his own lust, and enticed.
controles.kjv: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
controles.livre: Mas cada um é tentado quando é atraído e seduzido pelo seu próprio mau desejo.

versos.grego: εἶτα ἡ ἐπιθυμία συλλαβοῦσα τίκτει ἁμαρτίαν, ἡ δὲ ἁμαρτία ἀποτελεσθεῖσα ἀποκύει θάνατον.

controles.web: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin; and the sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
controles.kjv: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.
controles.livre: Depois do mau desejo ter concebido, dá à luz o pecado; e o pecado, quando é completado, gera a morte.

versos.grego: Μὴ πλανᾶσθε, ἀδελφοί μου ἀγαπητοί.

controles.web: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.
controles.kjv: Do not err, my beloved brethren.
controles.livre: Não vos enganeis, meus amados irmãos.

versos.grego: πᾶσα δόσις ἀγαθὴ καὶ πᾶν δώρημα τέλειον ἄνωθέν ἐστιν καταβαῖνον ἀπὸ τοῦ Πατρὸς τῶν φώτων, παρ’ ᾧ οὐκ ἔνι παραλλαγὴ ἢ τροπῆς ἀποσκίασμα.

controles.web: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.
controles.kjv: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
controles.livre: Toda boa dádiva e todo dom perfeito vem do alto, e desce do Pai das luzes, em quem não há mudança nem sombra de variação.

versos.grego: βουληθεὶς ἀπεκύησεν ἡμᾶς λόγῳ ἀληθείας, εἰς τὸ εἶναι ἡμᾶς ἀπαρχήν τινα τῶν αὐτοῦ κτισμάτων.

controles.web: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
controles.kjv: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
controles.livre: Conforme a sua própria vontade, ele nos gerou pela palavra da verdade, para que fôssemos os primeiros frutos dentre as suas criaturas.

versos.grego: Ἴστε, ἀδελφοί μου ἀγαπητοί. ἔστω δὲ πᾶς ἄνθρωπος ταχὺς εἰς τὸ ἀκοῦσαι, βραδὺς εἰς τὸ λαλῆσαι, βραδὺς εἰς ὀργήν·

controles.web: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
controles.kjv: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
controles.livre: Entendei isso , meus amados irmãos. Mas toda pessoa seja pronta para ouvir, tardia para falar, tardia para se irar;

versos.grego: ὀργὴ γὰρ ἀνδρὸς δικαιοσύνην Θεοῦ οὐκ ἐργάζεται.

controles.web: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
controles.kjv: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
controles.livre: porque a ira humana não cumpre a justiça de Deus.

versos.grego: διὸ ἀποθέμενοι πᾶσαν ῥυπαρίαν καὶ περισσείαν κακίας ἐν πραΰτητι δέξασθε τὸν ἔμφυτον λόγον τὸν δυνάμενον σῶσαι τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν.

controles.web: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
controles.kjv: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
controles.livre: Por isso, rejeitai toda impureza e abundância de malícia, e recebei com mansidão a palavra implantada em vós , que pode salvar as vossas almas;

versos.grego: γίνεσθε δὲ ποιηταὶ λόγου, καὶ μὴ ἀκροαταὶ μόνον παραλογιζόμενοι ἑαυτούς.

controles.web: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
controles.kjv: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
controles.livre: e sede praticantes da palavra, e não somente ouvintes, enganando a vós mesmos.

versos.grego: ὅτι εἴ τις ἀκροατὴς λόγου ἐστὶν καὶ οὐ ποιητής, οὗτος ἔοικεν ἀνδρὶ κατανοοῦντι τὸ πρόσωπον τῆς γενέσεως αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐσόπτρῳ·

controles.web: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;
controles.kjv: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
controles.livre: Pois, se alguém é ouvinte da palavra e não praticante, esse é semelhante a um homem que observa num espelho o seu rosto natural;

versos.grego: κατενόησεν γὰρ ἑαυτὸν καὶ ἀπελήλυθεν, καὶ εὐθέως ἐπελάθετο ὁποῖος ἦν.

controles.web: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.
controles.kjv: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
controles.livre: porque observou a si mesmo e saiu, e logo se esqueceu de como era.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ παρακύψας εἰς νόμον τέλειον τὸν τῆς ἐλευθερίας καὶ παραμείνας, οὐκ ἀκροατὴς ἐπιλησμονῆς γενόμενος ἀλλὰ ποιητὴς ἔργου, οὗτος μακάριος ἐν τῇ ποιήσει αὐτοῦ ἔσται.

controles.web: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom, and continues, not being a hearer who forgets, but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.
controles.kjv: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
controles.livre: Mas aquele que dá atenção à lei perfeita, a da liberdade, e nela persevera, não sendo ouvinte que esquece, mas sim praticante da obra, esse tal será bendito  no que fizer.

versos.grego: Εἴ τις δοκεῖ θρησκὸς εἶναι, μὴ χαλιναγωγῶν γλῶσσαν ἑαυτοῦ ἀλλὰ ἀπατῶν καρδίαν ἑαυτοῦ, τούτου μάταιος ἡ θρησκεία.

controles.web: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.
controles.kjv: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man’s religion is vain.
controles.livre: Se alguém pensa ser religioso, mas não controla a sua língua, então engana o seu próprio coração, e a religião desse é vã.

versos.grego: θρησκεία καθαρὰ καὶ ἀμίαντος παρὰ τῷ Θεῷ καὶ Πατρὶ αὕτη ἐστίν, ἐπισκέπτεσθαι ὀρφανοὺς καὶ χήρας ἐν τῇ θλίψει αὐτῶν, ἄσπιλον ἑαυτὸν τηρεῖν ἀπὸ τοῦ κόσμου.

controles.web: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
controles.kjv: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
controles.livre: A religião pura e não contaminada para com Deus e Pai é esta: visitar os órfãos e as viúvas nas suas aflições, e guardar a si mesmo sem a corrupção do mundo.
